title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: MACK/DRAG LINK TORQUE (10,438 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CLASS 8 HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS.  DURING ASSEMBLY, INSUFFICIENT TORQUE OCCURRED OF THE DRAG LINK TO THE AXLE STEERING ARM CONNECTION.  IF THE DRAG LINK TO AXLE STTERING ARM CONNECTION IS NOT TORQUED AND THE COTTER PIN IS NOT INSTALLED, THE NUT COULD BACK OFF DURING VEHICLE OPERATION.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/FMVSS 222/SEATS (2,391 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES.  THE FLIP SEATS INSTALLED ON THESE BUSES DO NOT MEET THE REARWARD PUSH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 222, "SCHOOL BUS PASSENGER SEATING AND CRASH PROTECTION."

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): AUTOLIV/HONDA/AIR BAG MODULE (9,558 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE FRONT PASSENGER AIR BAG MODULES HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED.  THE CLOTH FLAPS COVERING THE FOLDED AIR BAG MAY HAVE BEEN TUCKED IN TOO FAR.

title: RANCHO INDUSTRIES: RANCHO/STEERING RELAY ROD (800 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  AFTERMARKET STEERING RELAY ROD SYSTEMS USED IN 1988-1997 CHEVROLET 1/2 TON 4-WHEEL DRIVE, 6 LUG PICKUP TRUCKS.  THE RELAY ROD COULD FAIL.

title: Collins Bus Corporation: COLLINS BUS/OVERWEIGHT CONDITION (8 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  96" WIDE SCHOOL BUSES BUILT ON CHEVROLET CHASSIS (G VAN CUTAWAY MODEL 3500).  THESE BUSES WERE BUILT ON 10,000 LB. GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATING (GVWR) CHASSIS BUT SHOULD HAVE BEEN BUILT ON 12,000 LB. GVWR CHASSIS.  THE BUSES HAVE MORE DESIGNATED SEAT SPACES THAN THE GVWR IS PREPARED TO SUPPORT.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/FRONT AXLE HUBS (4,048 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH DESIGN LEVEL 1, ROCKWELL FF980 SERIES FRONT AXLE.  THE FRONT AXLE HUB FLANGE CAN DEVELOP CRACKS DUE TO HIGH STRESS LEVELS.

title: Ox Bodies, Inc.: OX BODIES/FMVSS 108 (5,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  8' TO 22' DUMP AND FLAT BED BODIES.  THE COMBINATION CLEARANCE LAMP/SIDE MARKERS ON THE SIDE OF THE BODIES DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: R. V. PRODUCTS: RV PRODUCTS/PC CONTROL BOARD (36,000 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  PRINTED CIRCUIT (PC) BOARD HOUSED IN THE ELECTRICAL CONTROL BOX ASSEMBLY EQUIPPED WITH THE VEHICLE'S AIR CONDITIONING UNIT.  AN ELECTRICAL RELAY ON THE PC BOARD WILL FAIL TO ACTIVATE.  WHEN THE RELAY FAILS TO ACTIVATE, OTHER ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS, AND THE PC BOARD ITSELF, ARE REQUIRED TO CARRY EXCESS ELECTRICAL CURRENT.

title: Mazda North American Operations: MAZDA/FUEL LINES (191 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  LIGHT DUTY 4X2 AND 4X4 PICKUP TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH 4.0L ENGINES. THE FLEXIBLE SECTION OF THE CHASSIS MOUNTED FUEL LINE THAT CONNECTS TO THE ENGINE WAS ROUTED TOO CLOSE TO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD.  THE LINE COULD CONTACT THE MANIFOLD.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/FUEL LEVEL SENDING UNIT (360,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   MULTI-PURPOSE PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE FUEL TANK MOUNTED FUEL LEVEL SENDING UNIT ACCURACY CAN DEGRADE OVER TIME, INDICATING SIGNIFICANTLY MORE FUEL IN RESERVE THAN IS ACTUALLY PRESENT.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/FMVSS 301 (16,338 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  FRONT AND REAR ENGINE SCHOOL BUSES EQUIPPED WITH 60 GALLON SIDE MOUNTED FUEL TANK BARRIERS.  THESE BUSES DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY."

title: redundant POLARIS INDUSTRIES, INC.: POLARIS/FMVSS CERTIFICATION (84 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  POLICE ALL PURPOSE VEHICLES SUPPLIED TO THE CITY OF CHICAGO, ILLINOIS.  THESE VEHICLES HAVE NOT BEEN CERTIFIED IN ACCORDANCE WITH PART 574 OF THE NATIONAL TRAFFIC AND MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY ACT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/FUEL TANK ROLLOVER VALVE (497,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  LIGHT DUTY PICKUP TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH GASOLINE ENGINES.  THE FUEL TANK MOUNTED ROLLOVER VALVE CAN ALLOW LIQUID FUEL TO LEAK ONTO THE GROUND UNDER CERTAIN VEHICLE OPERATING CONDITIONS.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/TIRES (25,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER MINIVANS EQUIPPED WITH P215/65R15 GOODYEAR CONQUEST TIRES MOUNTED ON STEEL WHEEL.  THE TIRES CAN EXPERIENCE A SUDDEN AIR PRESSURE LOSS WITHOUT WARNING.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/LOWER CONTROL ARM (599,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE LOWER CONTROL ARM BALL JOINT CAN SEPARATE DUE TO LOSS OF LUBRICATION.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/TRANSFER CASE/DRIVESHAFT (75,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  ALL WHEEL DRIVE PASSENGER MINIVANS.  THESE VEHICLES CAN DEVELOP POWERTRAIN BENDING RESONANCE OR TRANSFER CASE OUTPUT SHAFT BUSHING DISPLACEMENT.  THE POWERTRAIN BENDING RESONANCE OR THE OUTPUT SHAFT BUSHING DISPLACEMENT CAN RESULT IN STRUCTURAL FAILURE OF THE TRANSMISSION AND/OR TRANSFER CASE.  FLUID EXPLUSION, DRIVESHAFT SEPARATION OR LOSS OF VEHICLE DRIVE CAN RESULT.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ISUZU/FLOOR MATS (233 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MULTI-PURPOSE PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH A DRIVER'S SIDE OPTIONAL EQUIPMENT RUBBER FLOOR MAT.  REPEATED MOVEMENT OF THE DRIVER'S FEET AND ACTUATION OF THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL CAN RESULT IN A SHIFTING OF THE MAT'S POSITION.  THIS SHIFTING CAN CAUSE AN INTERFERENCE WITH THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): HONDA/FLOOR MATS (30 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MULTI-PURPOSE PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH A DRIVER'S SIDE OPTIONAL EQUIPMENT RUBBER FLOOR MAT.  REPEATED MOVEMENT OF THE DRIVER'S FEET AND ACTUATION OF THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL CAN RESULT IN A SHIFTING OF THE MAT'S POSITION.  THIS SHIFTING CAN CAUSE AN INTERFERENCE WITH THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/EXHAUST GAS LEAK (64,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTOR HOME CHASSIS.  HOT EXHAUST GASSES CAN LEAK FROM THE EXHAUST GAS RETURN (EGR) TUBE ON THE ENGINE.  A HOLE CAN DEVELOP IN THE FLEXIBLE SECTION OF THE TUBE.  HEAT DAMAGE TO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT FLOOR AND FLOOR COVERING CAN OCCUR.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: SUBARU/HAZARD WARNING LIGHT SWITCH (19,730 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE WITHIN THE HAZARD WARNING LIGHT SWITCH HOUSING CAN CAUSE A BINDING BETWEEN THE ACTUATING BUTTON AND THE HOUSING.

title: Daimler Commercial Buses NA: ORION/CNG SOLENOID VALVES (211 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  COMPRESSED NATURAL GAS (CNG) POWERED TRANSIT BUSES.  THE SOLENOID VALVE OR CHECK VALVE COULD ALLOW CNG TO FLOW WHEN NOT REQUIRED.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/BRAKE PIPE CONTACTS PS ASSEMBLY (4,387 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE RIGHT FRONT BRAKE PIPE CAN CONTACT THE PIOWER STEERING ASSEMBLY CAUSING THE BRAKE LINE TO WEAR THROUGH.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/CNG SOLENOID VALVE (1,800 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  BI-FUEL VEHICLES MODIFIED TO RUN ON EITHER GASOLINE OR COMPRESSED NATURAL GAS (CNG).  THE NATURAL GAS FUEL TANKS HAVE A SOLENOID SHUT-OFF VALVE THAT STOPS FUEL FLOW FROM THE FUEL TANK IN THE EVENT OF CERTAIN MODERATE TO SEVERE COLLISIONS.  IF THE VEHICLE IS IN A COLLISION AND THE NATURAL GAS FUEL LINE IS DAMAGED, THE SYSTEM COULD LEAK NATURAL GAS.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO TRUCK/FRONT AXLE WHEEL (923 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CLASS 8 HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS.  THE STEER AXLE WHEEL BEARING JAM NUT LOCK WASHER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN BENT OVER THE JAM NUT AFTER THE WHEEL BEARINGS WERE ADJUSTED.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: MACK/WEBB WHEEL STEER AXLE HUBS (25 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CLASS 8 HEAVY DUTY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH STEERING AXLE HUBS BUILT BY WEBB WHEEL FOR USE ON TRUCKS AND TRACTORS, PART NUMBERS WEBB 1530, VOLVO 90402-0006, OR EATON F1960.   THE STEERING AXLE HUB FLANGE CAN FRACTURE AND SEPARATE FROM THE CENTER PORTION OF THE HUB.

title: Mazda North American Operations: MAZDA/AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT RAIL (134,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH FRONT SEAT AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELTS.  THE RAIL OF THE AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT CAN WEAR SUFFICIENTLY SUCH THAT THE CABLE WHICH RETRACTS THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY CAN BECOME JAMMED IN THE RAIL RENDERING THE SHOULDER BELT INOPERATIVE.

title: MANCHESTER TANK & EQUIPMENT CO: MANCHESTER TANK/LPG CYLINDER (900 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  LIQUID PROPANE GAS (LPG) CYLINDERS EQUIPPED WITH AN OVERFILL PROTECTION.  THE OVERFILL PROTECTION DEVICE MAY NOT FUNCTION PROPERLY.

title: Lotus Cars Limited: LOTUS/WHEELS (11 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  CERTAIN WHEELS WERE NOT PROPERLY HEAT TREATED FOR HARDNESS.   THE REAR WHEELS COULD CRACK AND BREAK.

title: ARVINMERITOR AUTOMOTIVE: ROCKWELL-WABCO/ABS CONTROL UNITS (18,830 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  ANTILOCK BRAKING SYSTEM (ABS) ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNITS (ECU)  FOR OVER-THE-ROAD TRAILER APPLICATIONS.  THE COVER SEAL (O-RING) MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY INSTALLED IN CERTAIN EASY-STOP TRAILER ABS ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNITS.  AN INCORRECTLY INSTALLED SEAL COULD PERMIT WATER TO ENTER THE ECU CAUSING A FAULT TO DEVELOP.  THIS WILL CAUSE THE VEHICLE'S TRAILER ABS WARNING LAMP TO ILLUMINATE IMMEDIATELY WHEN THE WATER CONTACTS THE BOARD, DEACTIVATING ALL OR PART OF THE ABS.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: TOYOTA/KEY INTERLOCK (289,326 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  DUE TO A POSSIBLE JAMMING OF THE LOCK PIN OF THE KEY INTERLOCK SOLENOID, IT IS POSSIBLE TO REMOVE THE IGNITION KEY EVEN WHEN THE SHIFT LEVER OF THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION IS NOT IN THE "PARK" POSITION.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/FRONT AXLE HUBS (480 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH DESIGN LEVEL 1, ROCKWELL FF980 SERIES FRONT AXLE.  THE FRONT AXLE HUB FLANGE CAN DEVELOP CRACKS DUE TO HIGH STRESS LEVELS.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: PACCAR/FRONT AXLE HUBS (470 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH DESIGN LEVEL 1, ROCKWELL FF980 SERIES FRONT AXLE.  THE FRONT AXLE HUB FLANGE CAN DEVELOP CRACKS DUE TO HIGH STRESS LEVELS.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FMVSS 114 (1,100 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MULTI-PURPOSE PASSENGER VEHICLES, EDDIE BAUER AND LIMITED EDITIONS.  THE KEY-IN-IGNITION/DOOR OPEN WARNING CHIME MAY NOT FUNCTION WHEN THE DOOR IS OPENED.  THIS DOES NOT FULLY COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 114, "THEFT PROTECTION."

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FUEL RAILS (8,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH 4.6L ENGINES.   SOME OF THESE VEHICLES HAS MISSING OR INADEQUATE BRAZE JOINTS BETWEEN THE FUEL RAIL BODY AND THE FUEL RAIL MOUNTING BRACKET(S).

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/ABS MODULATOR (56,701 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE ANTILOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS) MODULATOR CAN CORRODE AND LEAK FLUID FROM THE FRONT BRAKE CIRCUIT.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/BRAKE HOSE FRACTURE (19,716 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  LIGHT DUTY PICKUP TRUCKS AND MULTI-PURPOSE PASSENGER VEHICLES.  A FATIGUE FRACTURE OF THE REAR AXLE RIGHT-HAND BRAKE PIPE CAN OCCUR CAUSING A SLOW BRAKE FLUID LEAK RESULTING IN A SOFT BRAKE PEDAL.  IF THE BRAKE PIPE BREAKS, THE DRIVER WOULD EXPERIENCE A SUDDEN DROP IN THE BRAKE PEDAL, THE INSTRUMENT PANEL BRAKE LIGHT WOULD ILLUMINATE, AND THERE WOULD BE A LOSS OF REAR BRAKE PERFORMANCE.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/WHEEL LUG NUTS (24 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE WHEEL LUG NUTS WERE NOT TIGHTENED SECURELY RESULTING IN A FRACTURE OF THE WHEEL STUDS.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: COOPER/LABELING (607 affected)
summary: TIRE DESCRIPTION: COOPER TRENDSETTER SE P215/70R14 (SERIAL NO. 3DHYC2J367, MANUFACTURED SEPTEMBER 7 - 13, 1997; MULTI-MILE MATRIX, P215/70R14 (SERIAL NO. 3DHYTMN367, SEPTEMBER 7 - 13, 1997; AND WESTERN AUTO SENTRY PREMIER II A/S P215/70R14 (SERIAL NO. 3DHYUDH367, SEPTEMBER 7 -13, 1997.)  THESE TIRES MAY NOT HAVE ADEQUATE RUBBER COVERAGE OF THE BELT EDGE IN THE SHOULDER SLOTS, RESULTING IN A SEPARATION.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/WIRING-HARNESS CLIP (33,973 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  LIGHT DUTY PICKUP TRUCKS AND MULTI-PURPOSE VEHICLES.  AN ENGINE ELECTRICAL WIRING-HARNESS CLIP CAN MELT AND DRIP ONTO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ISUZU/WIRING-HARNESS CLIP (1,299 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  LIGHT DUTY PICKUP TRUCKS AND MULTI-PURPOSE VEHICLES.  AN ENGINE ELECTRICAL WIRING-HARNESS CLIP CAN MELT AND DRIP ONTO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD.

title: COACHMEN INDUSTRIES, INC.: COACHMEN/DEXTER AXLE/WHEEL BEARINGS (219 affected)
summary: VEHICLE  DESCRIPTION:  TRAVEL AND FOLDING TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH DEXTER AXLES.   THE WHEEL BEARINGS USED IN SOME OF THESE AXLES HAVE A METALLURGICAL DEFECT CAUSING EARLY FAILURE.
